name: After recital AM – 4
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: AMa. whereas following the despicable terrorist attack in a Greek Orthodox Church in Jordan’s Karak governorate in October 2026, the Jordanian military launched strikes on targets in the Dara’a province in Syria that were identified as linked to the attack, leading to tensions between Jordan and Syria and the momentary closure of their shared border, due to a lack of coordination prior to these strikes being launched; whereas laudable diplomatic efforts have been made to de-escalate the tensions since this event;
